infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Tagged uses the camera so you can spray graffiti onto real-world surfaces.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Tagged uses your location to anchor graffiti to the place you painted it and to find pieces near you.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Tagged uses motion sensors to aim the spray can and to detect you shaking it.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Tagged does not record audio; this is required by the camera module.
